V4 Flash and Vision Exp were consolidated into V4.1 Flash. <strong>V4 Pro keeps running after 9/14</strong> (the 9/14 routing notice was withdrawn). MIT license. Peak/off-peak pricing since 2026-08-16. <a href=\"/en/deepseek-v4-1-flash/\">Guide</a> · <a href=\"/en/deepseek-v4-pro/\">What changes</a> · <a href=\"/en/pricing/#dh\">Pricing</a>.</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">Qwen / Alibaba</span><h3>Qwen (通义千问 / Alibaba Cloud)</h3>\n\n<p><strong>Qwen4-Max (GA 15 Nov 2026; the current flagship)</strong> offers a 1M-token context (up to 991K input, 131K output, 262K when thinking) with text, image and video input. On Alibaba Cloud Model Studio (QwenCloud) the published rates are <strong>$1.50 input / $4.50 output / $0.075 implicit cache</strong> per 1M tokens; explicit cache writes cost $1.875 (5-minute TTL) and $3.00 (1-hour TTL). After a Token-Plan-only preview from 11 Nov (<code>qwen4-max-preview</code>), prices were published and the model moved to general availability on 15 Nov. Benchmarks and weight availability are unconfirmed here. <a href=\"/en/pricing/#qwen-h\">Pricing</a>.</p><p class=\"legacy\"><strong>Previous generation</strong>: flagship Qwen3.8-Max (GA 3 Aug 2026, 2.4T MoE, 1M context) and the low-cost <strong>Qwen3.8-Flash</strong> (26 Aug 2026, 125B/6B active MoE, a Qwen4-architecture preview; <a href=\"/en/qwen-3-8-flash/\">details</a>). Open-weight Flash-Next is published on HF/ModelScope (licence terms unconfirmed).</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">GLM / Zhipu</span><h3>GLM (Zhipu AI / Z.ai)</h3><p>Tsinghua-affiliated lab. GLM-5.2 (2026-06-16) is a 744B MoE under MIT; GLM-5.3 (2026-08-14) ships at the same price. GLM-5.3-Flash (2026-08-26) is a 320B/18B MoE, natively multimodal, at list $0.15/$0.50. First foundation-model AI to IPO (Hong Kong, Jan 2026). <a href=\"/en/glm-5-3-flash/\">GLM 5.3 Flash details</a>.</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">Kimi / Moonshot</span><h3>Kimi (Moonshot AI)</h3><p><strong>Kimi K3.1 Pro (2026-10-23, current flagship)</strong>: 1M-token context, built for long-running agents in coding, 3D work and financial research; the official wording is \"our most capable 3T-class model to date\". <strong>$2.00 input / $10.00 output / $0.20 cached input</strong> per 1M tokens direct from Moonshot. A <strong>K3.1 Pro Highspeed</strong> variant runs roughly 2-3x faster at the same quality.</p><ul><li><strong>Pick this one</strong>: cheaper and stronger than K3 (2026-07). There is no reason to start on K3 now.</li><li><strong>Constraints</strong>: thinking is low/high/max only (high by default) and disabling it returns a 400. Cache writes cost $2.00 (5 min TTL) or $4.00 (1 hour TTL).</li></ul><p class=\"legacy\"><strong>Previous models (history)</strong>: K3 (2026-07-16, 2.8T parameters, native vision, $3.00/$15.00) and K2.6 (2026-04, reported on par with GPT-5.5 on SWE-bench Pro). Kimi became available on Amazon Bedrock in 2026-09.</p><details class=\"legacy\"><summary>Data handling via Bedrock (checked 2026-09-25)</summary><p>Kimi's Bedrock model card says nothing about data handling, so the Bedrock-wide terms apply: zero operator access (ZOA) and no storage of inputs or outputs by default (ZDR), and Kimi is not on the list of models with mandatory retention. To guarantee zero retention, set <code>data_retention_mode: none</code> (<a href=\"https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/data-retention.html\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener\">data retention</a>).</p></details></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">MiniMax</span><h3>MiniMax (M3 / M3.1 Flash)</h3><p>An independent Shanghai lab, like Kimi. Where Kimi targets long-context, high-price work, MiniMax focuses on <strong>low-cost agent workloads</strong>. <strong>MiniMax M3</strong> (2026-05/06) is a 1M-context multimodal MoE and M2.7 was open-sourced on 2026-04-12. <strong>M3.1-Flash</strong> is $0.15 in / $0.60 out / $0.015 cached read; M3 is $0.30/$1.20 up to 512K input (list $0.60/$2.40 with \"permanent 50% off\") and $0.60/$2.40 above 512K (MiniMax official pricing, checked 2026-11-21). <a href=\"#compare-h\">Pricing table</a>.</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">StepFun</span><h3>StepFun (阶跃星辰)</h3><p>A Chinese AI startup. Its official documentation splits pricing by model category, and one of those categories is <strong>&ldquo;Multimodal Reasoning Models&rdquo;</strong>, where as of 2026-10-13 it lists <strong>step-5-preview</strong> ($1.00 / $2.70) and <strong>step-3.7-flash</strong> ($0.20 / $1.15), with cached input at $0.10 and $0.04 respectively. The wider catalogue spans text-only, vision, speech and image generation &mdash; for speech, stepaudio-2.5-realtime ($1.50/$10.00) and step-audio-r1.5 ($1.43/$15.00), among others. <a href=\"#stepfun-h\">See the pricing split</a>.</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">Xiaomi / MiMo</span><h3>Xiaomi (小米 / MiMo)</h3><p>The AI research arm of smartphone maker Xiaomi. The <strong>MiMo-V2.6 series (announced 2026-09-22)</strong> is pitched as &ldquo;natively omnimodal&rdquo; and ships in three variants: <strong>MiMo-V2.6-Pro</strong> (top capability), <strong>MiMo-V2.6-Flash</strong> (the intelligence/efficiency/cost balance), and <strong>MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed</strong> (same quality at up to 20x output speed). Its official model page confirms <strong>text, image, video and audio input, text output, and a 1M-token context window</strong>. API pricing is <strong>unchanged from V2.5</strong>: Flash $0.14/$0.28, Pro $0.435/$0.87, Pro-UltraSpeed $4.35/$8.7 (cache-miss input / output). Xiaomi claims MiMo-V2.6-Pro scores <strong>46.32</strong> on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3, &ldquo;surpassing Kimi K3 and Qwen3.8 Max to become the strongest open-source model to date&rdquo;. The team works &ldquo;built in public&rdquo;: the technical report, training environment and RL code are released, and the production RL run was live-streamed. <a href=\"#compare-h\">Pricing table</a>.</p></div>\n  <div class=\"lab-card\"><span class=\"lab-tag\">Others</span><h3>ByteDance Doubao / Baidu ERNIE / Tencent Hunyuan</h3><p>ByteDance's Doubao (豆包) is a leading consumer assistant (closed). Baidu's ERNIE 5.x is omnimodal (only ERNIE 4.5 is open-source). Tencent open-sourced Hunyuan-A13B.</p></div>\n</div>\n"
